name: Solomon's Law
summary: In Lakeshire, Solomon's Law puts the Shadowhide gnolls under sentence of death for aiding Morganth, an enemy of Stormwind. Bailiff Conacher issues the decree from the town hall and seeks proof that the sentence has been carried out.

sections.title: Frontier Justice in Lakeshire
sections.body: Lakeshire governs Redridge with little military help from Stormwind. Magistrate Solomon and the town officials rely on strict frontier authority to keep order. Bailiff Conacher works from the town hall as the magistrate court's arm. When threats reach the township, the court places bounties on offenders and depends on hired mercenaries and traveling defenders to uphold the kingdom's laws.

sections.title: Aiding an Enemy of the Crown
sections.body: The Shadowhide clan faces execution for aiding Morganth, a rogue spellcaster in the eastern hills. Lakeshire and Stormwind law calls for death when someone directly helps a declared enemy of the realm. The gnolls carry out Morganth's bidding, so the court treats them as treasonous fighters rather than wild scavengers.

faq.q: Who is Solomon and what is his law?
faq.answer: Solomon is Magistrate Solomon, Lakeshire's civilian leader. His local decrees and Stormwind's statutes make aiding a declared enemy of the kingdom treason, punishable by death.

faq.q: Who is Morganth and why does Lakeshire care about him?
faq.answer: Morganth is a rogue practitioner of the Arcane who lives in Redridge's eastern foothills. Stormwind has branded him an enemy, and he uses foul magic to terrorize townsfolk and bend the Shadowhide gnolls to his will.

faq.q: Why are the Shadowhide gnolls being hunted specifically?
faq.answer: The Shadowhide gnolls are hunted because they serve Morganth, the dark wizard. Their alliance makes them lawful targets for execution under the town decree.
The Shadowhide gnolls' pendants prove their deaths. Bailiff Conacher requires ten before the court certifies the sentence has been carried out and grants a bounty.

faq.q: Where does Bailiff Conacher conduct his business?
faq.answer: Bailiff Conacher works inside Lakeshire Town Hall with Magistrate Solomon and the other civil officials who manage Redridge.

faq.q: Why doesn't Stormwind send royal soldiers to deal with this?
faq.answer: Stormwind's kingdom is stretched thin and troubled by political paralysis and unrest across its territories. Lakeshire's requests for soldiers have repeatedly gone unanswered, leaving Magistrate Solomon to hire adventurers.

angles.text: Upholding Solomon's decree supports the law on the eastern frontier, where Stormwind's regular forces are conspicuously absent.
As a paladin, you bring holy justice and protection to besieged frontier towns by punishing gnolls who willingly serve a dark sorcerer.
As a mage, you face Morganth's agents as a priority, for he has turned Arcane knowledge toward dark terror.
